134: (8) Shows etc. - The Mechaber wrote this law before the laws of lifting and rolling because this is the Sephardic custom to lift before the reading, and see later in the Rema that our custom is to do the lifting after the reading. The one who lifts the Torah scroll lifts it above the ark to show to the people, rolling it to three columns and lifts it. And it is possible that specifically three [columns] was stated [Magen Avraham], but in my opinion it depends on the strength of the lifter - that he should be able to lift it when it is rolled a lot.
